unete.faq1Q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
unete.faq1A: Yes. You cancel from your account, in the Subscription tab, with no lock-in.
unete.faq2Q: What happens when the free trial ends?
unete.faq2A: The plan you chose becomes active and Stripe makes the first charge on the indicated date.
unete.faq3Q: How do I get access after paying?
unete.faq3A: If you don’t have an account yet, you will receive an email with a link to set your password and get straight in.
unete.faq4A: The payment is processed securely by Stripe. You can apply a coupon on the payment screen.
